visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in a brightly lit indoor living room. A grey and white tabby cat is perched high atop a white modular cabinet. A person's hand with black nail polish and a gold ring reaches up toward the cat. The background consists of a plain white ceiling and soft indoor lighting. (2) The cat yawns broadly, showing its teeth and stretching its front legs while looking down at the person. Yellow and white variety-style text overlays appear in the center of the frame as the camera slightly shakes, indicating a handheld shot. (3) The cat begins to walk along the very top edge of the cabinet. The camera pans right to follow its movement. A gap between cabinets reveals wires and lighting fixtures. (4) The cat pauses, looking down, and then jumps onto a lower wooden cabinet. The person's hand remains in the shot, guiding the cat. (5) The cat continues to jump down, landing on a white surface and then onto the light-colored tiled floor. The person's hand pets the cat's head as it walks past a blue and red pet carrier. (6) The scene cuts to the cat lying on a grey fabric ottoman. Behind it, a tall glass display case is filled with a large collection of yellow Winnie the Pooh plush toys. A white fan and photography tripods with ring lights are visible in the background. (7) The person places their hand on a white table in the foreground, rubbing their thumb and index finger together in a calling gesture. The cat watches intently from the ottoman. (8) The cat jumps off the ottoman and trots toward the camera. The camera moves backward to maintain the shot as the cat approaches the table. (9) The person's hand pets the cat's head vigorously. The cat closes its eyes and leans into the touch. The shot is a close-up, focusing on the cat's facial features and the interaction. (10) The camera captures a close-up of the cat's face as the person continues to pet it. The cat looks around, and the video ends with more petting and variety text overlays appearing around the cat's head.
